title: Battle of Manila (1574)
text: The Battle of Manila (1574) was a battle between Chinese and Japanese pirates led by Limahong and Spanish colonial forces with their native allies that took place on 29 November 1574 near Manila, mainly in the location of what is now Parañaque, in the Philippines. It marked the first time the Spanish directly clashed with the Japanese, the latter of whom had occasionally tried to colonize the Philippines and claim sovereignty.
